# Load Libraries

```{r}
# install cmribio from github
# library(pak)
# pak::pkg_install("jmvarberg/cmribio")

library(cmribio)
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)
library(ggsci)
library(ggpubr)
library(rstatix)
library(data.table)
library(DT)

# download logo to use for example
logo <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jmvarberg/cmribio/main/man/figures/logo.png"
dest <- "logo.png"

download.file(logo, dest, mode = "wb")
```

## Tables and Graphs

Include separate sections and chunks used to generate results tables and plots during the analysis.

### Static and Interactive Tables

Here are simple examples of how to make static or interactive tables.

```{r tables}
# static table output
mtcars |>
  knitr::kable()

# interactive table output
mtcars |>
  cmribio::cmri_datatable()
```

### Static and Interactive Plots

Here are basic examples of using static and interactive plots.

```{r fig-static-plot, fig.cap="Static mtcars plot"}
p <- ggplot(
  mtcars,
  aes(
    x = mpg,
    y = wt,
    color = factor(cyl),
    text1 = disp,
    text2 = drat,
    text3 = qsec,
    text4 = gear,
    text5 = carb
  )
) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_bcb() +
  theme_bcb(base_theme = "bw")

p +
  ggtitle("Static Plot Output")
```

```{r fig-interactive-plot}
library(plotly)

pp <- p +
  ggtitle("ggplotly Interactive Output")

ggplotly(pp)
```

You can also modify the size of the plot generated by each chunk like this:

```{r}
p
```

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=12}
p
```

# Embedded Files

The function `xfun::embed_file()` can be used to directly embed results files, like CSVs or Excel files, into the document. It will then be self-contained, so anyone with the report can download the embedded file.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
# create results directory if needed
dir.create("./results", showWarnings = FALSE)

# create results data frame
results <- mtcars

# save results
write.csv(
  results,
  "./results/mtcars.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

# embed file in report
xfun::embed_file(
  "./results/mtcars.csv",
  "./results/mtcars.csv",
  "Results - mtcars.csv"
)
```
